summary: Completed backend and frontend verification of the connected Metro Motors workflow: save/edit, duplicate vehicle reuse, documents, bill generation/list/search/preview/edit, live finances, and mobile navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: The requested functional routes use the live workflow APIs and exclude MongoDB _id values; no critical relationship or serialization defect was reproduced.

The legacy Deals/Dashboard sections still contain static presentation data; this was not part of the exercised connected New Deal/Bills/Finances flow, but should be considered if those screens are expected to become live too.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ API records and one browser workflow deal were created and deleted; the browser deal workspace returned 404 after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Covered New Deal tabs including Files, save/edit by DEAL id, categorized upload/replace/delete, both bill types, live Bills search/preview/edit, live Finances, mobile navigation and overflow. No APIs were mocked. Finance totals include all persisted payments, so assertions should account for existing records.
rca of the issue: Two automation findings were test harness issues: the first used hyphenated vehicle field IDs while the component exposes underscore-based IDs, and the second waited for a hidden file input to be visible. Correcting selectors/waits allowed the workflow to pass. The aggregate finance total was ₹5,000 because another persisted paid sale payment existed; the live endpoint and UI were consistent.
